headline: NYM @ PHI matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is NYM 4.52 at PHI 4.76, with a projected total of 9.28. Movement read: Both offenses moved up (NYM +0.85, PHI +0.96), so the movement is more about a higher-scoring game environment than a stronger side. The projected total climbed +1.76, which points to more offensive expectation than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability dropped -21.5%, so the first-inning read became more YRFI/early-scoring friendly. Pitching context: Sean Manaea has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 1.4 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Bo Bichette, Bryson Stott, Brandon Marsh, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Jared Young, Bryce Harper because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
